title: Zuno Agent RAG Domain Note (OKF v0.2 Markdown bundle frontmatter)
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of agents/<name>/rag/<domain>.md (ADR-0513, promoting agents/<name>/rag/ from the ADR-0502 stub to real Stage-2 content). `rag`/`tool`/`policy` are Zuno-invented document kinds with no OKF-core meaning - every field below is [ZUNO EXT]. One file documents retrieval tuning for exactly one logical knowledge domain (ADR-0202) already reachable by this agent, i.e. present in some agents/<name>/tasks/*.md's `zuno.allowed_knowledge`. This document is descriptive only, like ADR-0503's generated Authorization matrix: it narrows or explains what agent.okf.md (`zuno.rag.top_k`), tasks/*.md (`zuno.allowed_knowledge`) and policies/knowledge/knowledge-policy.yaml already declare/authorize - it never grants retrieval access on its own and must never become an enforcement input (ADR-0503 Security considerations apply identically here). Consumed today only by platform/supply-chain/validate_okf_bundle.py's cross-reference check; no runtime service reads this file.

okf_version.description: [OKF CORE] OKF envelope version this document conforms to.

type.description: [OKF CORE shape, ZUNO-defined kind] Document kind. Always "rag" for files under agents/<name>/rag/.

title.description: [OKF CORE] Human-readable title, e.g. "Technical documentation retrieval".

zuno.description: [ZUNO EXT] The knowledge domain this note documents, and the retrieval tuning this agent recommends for it.

domain.description: Logical knowledge-domain ID (knowledge/<domain>/domain.yaml, ADR-0202) this note documents. Must be one this agent can actually reach: present in at least one entry of `used_by_tasks` below's own `zuno.allowed_knowledge`.

used_by_tasks.description: Which of this agent's tasks (agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md) declare `domain` above in their `zuno.allowed_knowledge`. Documents an existing fact; adding a task name here grants nothing - the task's own frontmatter is the actual ceiling.

top_k_hint.description: Suggested per-domain override of the agent-wide `zuno.rag.top_k` (agent.okf.md) when this domain benefits from a different result count. Documentary only - Agent Runtime's retrieve node reads agent.okf.md's `zuno.rag.top_k`, not this field; changing this value changes nothing at runtime until a maintainer also edits agent.okf.md.

filters.description: Narrowing hints for which slice of the domain this agent's tasks actually need, expressed in the domain's own taxonomy (knowledge/<domain>/domain.yaml's `taxonomy`). Documentary/advisory only - components/rag-service does not read this file, so these are not enforced query filters, only a record of intent for whoever tunes ingestion or retrieval prompts.

technology.description: Subset of the domain's technology_vocabulary (knowledge.tech only) this agent cares about.

source_classes.description: Subset of the domain's taxonomy.source_classes this agent prioritizes.

freshness_expectation.description: Which of the domain's declared operation classes (knowledge/<domain>/domain.yaml's `freshness.operation_classes`) this agent's use of the domain matches. Documentary cross-reference, not a distinct staleness policy.

rationale.description: Free-text: why this agent needs this domain.
